page.notes: No marginal notes on this page; the right side is blank. The black ink blots and the "Google" watermark at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted. Doubtful readings: "ضدم" and "خالف" in the last Arabic line (diacritics unclear); "asferunt" as printed; "Aspahaniensis" (printed "Afpahanienfis") and "AbulHafan" as printed. The italic/roman boundary in the Latin is uncertain from line 14 onward; the upper lines are set in italic, and I have marked the Latin of the first thirteen lines as italic, with the rest in roman except "Al-Motazalos" and the gloss "Deum omnia creare". The Arabic words on lines 21–24 are split across the printed lines; I have kept them in the printed order. Catchword "الطاعة" is printed at the foot, right.
